_about: Follow-through (docs/animation/secondary-motion.md). Loose parts of the body lag behind the body and swing past on every change of its velocity and on every blow: the head and the upper back, and the two forearms (hanging free, they trail a run, fling up at a landing and swing on after a hit). One damped spring per part (`stiff`, `damp`), stepped once per sim tick beside the sash and pack cloth, so a replay shows the same. A part is kicked by the change in the body's velocity over the tick (`dv_ref`: the change in units a tick, along the way he faces and up, that is a full kick; `gx` and `gy` are the part's turn in radians a second at a full kick along and up, signed: a positive turn swings a down-pointing part forward and an up-pointing part back) and by a blow (`hit`: radians a second at a force of `force_ref`, away from the blow). `max` bounds the angle. Fighters: `scale` is the size of the follow-through (the Protagonist loose, the Anti-hero tight) and `damp` the damping scale. Under reduced motion it is 0.5; a frozen tick (hit-stop) runs at a tenth. Render only, outside the sim's data hash. First values, Animation's.
